description: This file defines the internal sealed class 'ReminderTableGrain' which implements reminder table management for Orleans grains. It includes methods for reading, inserting, and removing reminders, as well as migration and logging functionalities.

classes.name: ReminderTableGrain
classes.description: Implements the reminder table for grains, providing CRUD operations for reminders, migration support, and logging.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Handles activation logic for the grain.

methods.name: OnDeactivateAsync
methods.description: Handles deactivation logic for the grain.

methods.name: TestOnlyClearTable
methods.description: Clears the reminder table, intended for testing purposes.

methods.name: ReadRows
methods.description: Reads reminders for a specific grain ID.

methods.name: ReadRows
methods.description: Reads reminders within a specific range.

methods.name: ReadRow
methods.description: Reads a specific reminder entry by grain ID and reminder name.

methods.name: UpsertRow
methods.description: Inserts or updates a reminder entry.

methods.name: RemoveRow
methods.description: Removes a reminder entry if the eTag matches.

methods.name: OnDehydrate
methods.description: Handles the dehydration process for migration.

methods.name: OnRehydrate
methods.description: Handles the rehydration process for migration.
